outcome: Install pinned Quint/Apalache and Hypothesis locally, provide repeatable setup and execution, validate real failures and make verified profiles ready for Harness registration
non_goals: Change production gates or claim model-to-code equivalence proof

acceptance.statement: A documented setup command installs pinned dependencies in local managed directories and checks versions and Apalache archive integrity
Quint/Apalache verifies the Harness evidence acceptance model and detects the stale-evidence guard mutation with a saved counterexample
Hypothesis executes action sequences against real Harness evidence gates and detects a simulated missing freshness check
Wrapper outputs include real tool exit codes, versions, model hashes or test settings; unavailable tools and unexpected failures do not become PASS
User-facing commands, prerequisites, limits and capability registration are documented and offline-discoverable

reasons: New validation boundary and distributed operator guidance; existing process and delivery contracts remain unchanged

constraints: Use existing jsonschema evaluator, offline references only
Keep policy, baseline and enabled capabilities unchanged
Register no unrequested project-specific verification commands
